import json,sys,hashlib,stat
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('research/styles-firmware-20261022');sys.path.insert(0,str(r))

paths={'producer':a.path('inputs/0-producer.ll'),'guided':[a.path(n)for n in COMPILE_SETS['chain'][1:4]],'main':a.path('inputs/4-main-observed.ll'),'plain':a.path('inputs/plain-main.ll')}

 expected_proofs.extend([record['pre_input_proof'],record['post_input_proof']])

 assert hashlib.sha256(encoded(private['actual_argv'])).hexdigest()==record['argv_sha256']
 assert a.redact(private['actual_argv'])==record['argv_redacted']

 for suffix,key in [('stdout','stdout_sha256'),('stderr','stderr_sha256')]:
  name='logs/'+label+'.'+suffix;assert sha(a.path(name))==record[key];logs[name]=record[key]
  name='logs/'+label+'-dependencies.'+suffix;assert sha(a.path(name))==record['dependencies'][key];logs[name]=record['dependencies'][key]

 f=a.path('proofs/'+proof['name']+'.json');data=json.loads(f.read_text());assert sha(f)==proof['sha256'];assert data['all_SHA_match'];assert data['sealed_manifest_sha256']==prepared['private_manifest_sha256'];proofs[proof['name']]=sha(f)
assert len(proofs)==len(expected_proofs)==len(list(a.path('proofs').glob('*.json')))
assert sha(a.path('run-result.private.json'))==result['private_result_sha256']
private_result=json.loads(a.path('run-result.private.json').read_text());assert private_result=={k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='private_result_sha256'}
assert len(prepared['actual_compiler_inputs'])==7 and result['total_completed_original_kernel_calls']==270 and result['new_146_state_search_calls']==0
assert result['status']=='passed_new_finite_boundary_baseline' and len(result['rows'])==8
assert stat.S_IMODE(a.root.stat().st_mode)==0o700
assert all(stat.S_IMODE(a.path(n).stat().st_mode)==0o400 for n in m['files'])
assert all(stat.S_IMODE(a.path(n).stat().st_mode)==0o600 for n in logs)
output={'scope':'read-only post-run audit of NEW S24 originals, compiler inputs, products, commands and logs; no new kernels or model calls','run_id':m['run_id'],'private_manifest_sha256':prepared['private_manifest_sha256'],'all_saved_input_and_product_SHA_match':True,'current_source_and_saved_snapshots_match':True,'fresh_field3_contract_recomputed_from_saved_files_matches':True,'catalog_search_sources_and_inputs_unchanged':True,'compiled_from_saved_sealed_paths':True,'sealed_input_count':len(m['files']),'compiler_input_count':7,'private_compilation_command_sha256':commands,'private_log_sha256':logs,'proof_sha256':proofs,'private_result_sha256':result['private_result_sha256'],'capacity':a.capacity(),'input_modes':'0400','run_root_mode':'0700','compiler_log_modes':'0600','new_original_kernel_calls':0,'new_model_calls':0,'historical_IR_equivalence_claim':False}
(p/'baseline-audit-s24c.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'run_id':m['run_id'],'all_checks_pass':True,'sealed_inputs':len(m['files']),'proofs':len(proofs),'retained_private_bytes':output['capacity']['used_bytes']}))
